hazards.description: Large white vans parked along the right side of the road block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway

hazards.name: Degraded pavement condition
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven asphalt surfaces create potential trip hazards for those walking in the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the roadway

hazards.name: Overhanging Load
hazards.description: Ladders on top of a parked van protrude significantly into the sidewalk space at head height.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left, overhanging the sidewalk from the white van

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement on the roadway and walkways creates tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Overgrown Vegetation
hazards.description: Dense brush on the right side completely obstructs the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street.

hazards.name: Blank Walls
hazards.description: High walls on both sides of the street reduce passive surveillance and create a hostile pedestrian environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street.

hazards.name: Vegetation Encroachment
hazards.description: Overgrown bushes and trees significantly reduce the usable width of the sidewalk and block sightlines.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left side of the sidewalk

hazards.name: Sidewalk Cracks and Weeds
hazards.description: Uneven pavement and vegetation growth in sidewalk joints create minor tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground sidewalk surface

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a formal sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk on garage aprons or in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway

hazards.name: Obstructed Walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right is narrow and contains utility poles and trees that restrict the clear walking path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side sidewalk

hazards.name: Multiple Driveway Conflicts
hazards.description: The continuous row of garage doors on the left creates numerous points where vehicles may cross the pedestrian path without clear sightlines.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side frontage

hazards.name: Lack of Passive Surveillance
hazards.description: High concrete walls and chain-link fencing create a 'tunnel' effect with no active building frontages, which can impact personal security.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street along the property lines

hazards.name: Continuous Curb Cut
hazards.description: The entire frontage of the building is a dropped curb for garage access, leaving no protected or defined space for pedestrians and allowing vehicles to cross the walking path at any point.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire paved area in front of the brick building.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no physical barrier or vertical separation between the travel lane and the area where a pedestrian would walk.
hazards.location_in_image: The transition between the asphalt road and the concrete apron.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated pedestrian crossing points visible along this stretch of road.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway

hazards.name: Blank frontages
hazards.description: High retaining walls and fences create a lack of passive surveillance, which can impact pedestrian comfort and security.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk is heavily cracked with vegetation growing through, creating significant tripping hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground walkway

hazards.name: Narrow and Obstructed Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right is extremely narrow and obstructed by utility poles, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the retaining wall.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A tree trunk is located in the middle of the sidewalk, significantly reducing the clear width and creating a major barrier for people with disabilities or those using strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground

hazards.name: Wide roadway without calming
hazards.description: The wide, open asphalt with minimal markings may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground roadway

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-scale lighting
hazards.description: While tall poles are visible for the courts, there is no visible street-level lighting for the sidewalk itself, which may impact safety at night.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk length

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no paved sidewalks, forcing pedestrians to walk in the travel lane alongside vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible block

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and security during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffer
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and introduce a planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this narrow residential street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace damaged sidewalk panels using root-sensitive construction methods to provide a level, accessible surface.

interventions.title: Vegetation Trimming
interventions.description: Regularly prune private hedges to maintain the full clear width of the public sidewalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Expansion and Completion
interventions.description: Construct a new sidewalk on the left side and widen the existing sidewalk on the right to meet ADA standards.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Install street trees or a planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Wall Treatment / Public Art
interventions.description: Apply murals or vertical greenery to the retaining wall to improve the visual environment and reduce the hostile feel of the blank frontage.

interventions.description: Ensure adequate lighting is provided along this stretch to improve safety and visibility at night, given the lack of natural surveillance from adjacent buildings.
